scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process'); if(fs.existsSync('frontend')){cp.execSync('cd frontend && npm install && npm run build',{stdio:'inherit'})}else{cp.execSync('npx next build',{stdio:'inherit'})}"
scripts.start: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process'); if(fs.existsSync('frontend')){cp.execSync('cd frontend && npm run start',{stdio:'inherit'})}else{cp.execSync('npx next start',{stdio:'inherit'})}"
